ऌ: 1. ऌ the ninth vowel of the alphabet (resembling the sound ल्र्य् in रेवेल्र्य्; it only appears in some forms of √ कॢप्).
the earth, the mother of the gods, L.
ऌकार: ऌ—कार m. the sound ऌ, RPrāt.; APrāt.; TPrāt.
ऌवर्ण: ऌ—वर्ण m. the sound ऌ, RPrāt.; APrāt.; TPrāt.
